evidence.why: Accepted comparison, zero-frame entry and false fallthrough.

facts.rationale: Corrects the non-exhaustive greater-than-only rejection description and preserves the caller's actual floating-point guards.
facts.value: Run IASA reaches this predicate only when mv.co.run.x0 <= 0.0F evaluates true and earlier interrupts have not consumed the update. The predicate accepts exactly input.lstick[0].x * facing_dir <= x38_someLStickXThreshold, enters TurnRun at frame zero and returns true. If that comparison is false, including an unordered comparison involving NaN, it returns false without a state-entry call. Success prevents RunBrake processing. An unordered Run countdown fails the caller guard and also prevents RunBrake processing.

evidence.why: Exclusive special return and ordinary input priority.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exclusive Hammer branch rather than describing a failed special opportunity followed by ordinary input.
facts.value: Delegates once to fn_800CAF78 and performs no subsequent local work. If the fighter holds Hammer, the selector immediately returns ftCo_800C5A50's result, including false, without trying ordinary relaxed stick or button checks. Otherwise, upward stick at or above relaxed_tap_jump_threshold with tilt timer below tap_jump_window enters KneeBend with JumpInput_LStick; failing that, pressed X/Y enters KneeBend with JumpInput_XY. If neither ordinary check succeeds, the selector returns false.

evidence.why: Ordinary and special routes are exclusive.

facts.rationale: Qualifies the existing ordinary jumpsquat mapping without discarding it.
facts.value: Provides jump initiation from the running turnaround. Accepted non-Hammer input starts ordinary KneeBend, the grounded pre-jump action. Hammer possession instead routes exclusively through the Hammer-specific selector, so ordinary KneeBend is not the universal destination.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unconditional common-Fall promise while preserving the callback's responsibility.
facts.value: Handles TurnRun environmental collision: a false ft_800827A0 result invokes the Fall entry dispatcher and returns; otherwise either platform-edge flag invokes the common movement reset. The dispatcher does not guarantee ordinary Fall.

facts.rationale: Retains the three local collision outcomes and explicitly preserves exceptional downstream destinations.
facts.value: A false ft_800827A0 result calls ftCo_Fall_Enter and immediately returns, skipping edge handling. That dispatcher prioritizes Master Hand, Crazy Hand, x2224_b2 and Hammer alternatives before ordinary Fall. On a true collision result, neither edge flag causes no further local action; either Collide_LeftEdge or Collide_RightEdge invokes ftCommon_8007E2FC, clearing movement fields without a motion-state transition.

facts.rationale: Preserves the gameplay mapping without promising ordinary falling for every fighter configuration.
facts.value: Provides environmental handling for the running turnaround: ordinary grounded movement continues when no edge is reported, either reported platform edge arrests movement, and support loss routes through the Fall entry dispatcher. Ordinary falling is its fallback, with boss, x2224_b2 and Hammer alternatives.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unit-level destination claim while retaining its supported responsibilities.
facts.value: Implements common fighter TurnRun recognition and entry, animation-controlled facing reversal, jump-interrupt delegation, grounded physics and environmental handling. Collision support loss invokes the Fall entry dispatcher rather than guaranteeing ordinary Fall; reported edges invoke a movement reset.

evidence.why: Inputs, persistent fields and helper calls.

facts.rationale: Preserves the cross-callback data flow and narrows the downstream state assertion.
facts.value: Facing-relative stick input feeds the TurnRun predicates. Entry saves the original facing direction; animation consumes command, phase and ground-velocity state to reverse facing; physics consumes computed acceleration, target velocity and traction. Collision consumes the grounded-query result and edge flags, forwarding the object to the Fall entry dispatcher on false or the movement-reset helper on a grounded edge. The downstream dispatcher may select boss, x2224_b2 or Hammer alternatives instead of ordinary Fall.

facts.rationale: Retains the moving-turnaround mapping while removing the unconditional falling promise.
facts.value: Realizes the fighter's running turnaround through grounded traction, directional acceleration and animation-gated facing reversal. Detected edges reset movement. Support loss invokes the Fall entry dispatcher, whose ordinary falling outcome is qualified by boss, x2224_b2 and Hammer alternatives.

facts.rationale: Preserves the guarded lifecycle and qualifies its collision destination.
facts.value: Accepted facing-relative input enters TurnRun. An active command first pauses animation; a later active-command update resumes and reverses facing only when the signed middle_anim_frame * gr_vel comparison is <= 0.01F. Physics selects reverse-entry-facing acceleration or friction and always applies ground movement. IASA delegates jump handling. A false grounded collision result calls the Fall entry dispatcher and returns; otherwise either edge flag resets movement. Ordinary Fall is only the dispatcher's fallback after boss, x2224_b2 and Hammer alternatives.
